title: Snap Drag Carousel
summary: A row of poster cards that scrolls and snaps natively, can be dragged with the mouse and flicked, and is driven by square previous and next buttons, arrow keys and a progress line.
useWhen: Selected works strip for a graphic design studio or artist portfolio
Product or collection row on a fashion or publishing site where cards share one size
Any horizontal list that must work with touch, trackpad, mouse drag and keyboard
Replacing a JavaScript slider library with native scroll snapping
techniques: projected landing point handed to scrollTo smooth

whyItWorks.how: Touch and trackpad use native scrolling with no script in the way. Mouse drag starts after 4px (DRAG_THRESHOLD), captures the pointer, turns snapping off and writes scrollLeft once per animation frame, so the cards stay under the cursor with no lag.

On release the script measures velocity over the last 100ms of samples, projects the landing point 220ms ahead (PROJECTION_MS), picks the nearest snap point and hands it to scrollTo with smooth behaviour. A slow 140px drag settles back, a quick 200px flick advances one card.

Card hover is a 160ms ease-out shift of 6px (--lift) up and left that uncovers a fixed black block behind the card. It is a hard offset with no shadow animation, so moving across a row of cards stays fast and quiet.

Previous and next are real buttons that disable at each end. Left and Right arrows work anywhere in the region and move focus to the next card when a card has focus. Card :focus-visible gets the same 6px lift as hover plus a red caption, and a polite live region announces the work after button or key moves.
Position is native scrollLeft, never a transform on the track. The progress line is a scaleX on a 2px bar updated in a rAF-throttled scroll handler, and nothing else moves while scrolling.

directions.name: Luxury
directions.change: Use wide 3:4 photographs with no borders, a thin hairline progress bar, a serif caption, and a 0.5 opacity on cards that are not snapped.

directions.name: Playful
directions.change: Round the cards to 24px, give each a saturated background, and replace the black block lift with a 2deg rotate on hover and focus.

directions.name: Corporate
directions.change: Use 16:10 cards with a logo and metric, round buttons, a brand-blue progress bar, and drop the lift for a 1px border colour change.

pitfalls: Leaving scroll-snap on during a mouse drag. The browser fights every scrollLeft write and the track stutters.
Turning snap back on before the smooth scroll ends. Chrome snaps at once and the glide jumps. Wait for scrollend, with a timeout fallback.
Letting the drag end fire a click on the card under the cursor. Suppress the next click in the capture phase after a real drag.
Native link and image dragging. Without draggable=false and a dragstart preventDefault the browser starts a drag-and-drop and pointer events stop.
Moving the track with transforms. That breaks native touch scrolling, keyboard scrolling and focus scrolling at once.

tunables.name: PROJECTION_MS
tunables.effect: How far ahead release velocity is projected to choose the landing card.

tunables.name: DRAG_THRESHOLD
tunables.effect: Pixels the mouse must move before a press becomes a drag, so plain clicks still open cards.

tunables.name: --card-width
tunables.effect: Width of each card. 76vw on phones.

tunables.name: --lift
tunables.effect: How far a card shifts up and left on hover and focus.

reducedMotion: Buttons, arrow keys and drag release jump straight to the target card with scroll behaviour auto instead of gliding. The card lift and button arrow nudge happen without a transition.
